title: Ausgewählte Werke Bd. 2 (German, 1922)
author: Vladimir Solovyov
description: Ausgewählte Werke, Band 2 (Selected Works, Volume 2) of Vladimir Solovyov, translated from the Russian into German by Harry Köhler (Stuttgart: Der Kommende Tag Verlag, 1922, Philosophisch-Anthroposophische Bibliothek). This volume contains the Sonntags- und Osterbriefe (Sunday and Easter Letters), short essays written by Solovyov in the 1890s on religious, moral and social questions. Beginning with 'The Family of Peoples', they reflect on nations and universal humanity, Christianity and national life, the meaning of Easter and resurrection, the Church and the kingdom of God, and the duties of Christians in history. Together with the first volume, it presents to German readers the thought of the Russian philosopher of Divine Wisdom (Sophia), all-unity and Godmanhood, who influenced Berdyaev, Bulgakov and the Russian religious renaissance as well as Steiner's anthroposophical circle.
